scopePolicy.expectedScope: compare-only precondition; never an identity selector; mismatch fails before reads or writes

semantics.resetAndDelete: null custom document; tenant defaults resolved by host; revision retained
semantics.idempotency: same request UUID and fingerprint returns original receipt; bounded receipts; evicted retries conflict safely
semantics.migrations: versioned resource formats; explicit adoption of proven full-account local scopes only; never auto-import role-only keys
semantics.cache: dirty local drafts never overwritten; conflicts require explicit choice; mutations are never automatically retried
semantics.audit: successful mutations and revision conflicts; hashes and identity metadata only, no preference values
semantics.retention: documents and audit cascade on account/tenant deletion; receipts expire after 24h and cap at 100 per scoped actor; rate buckets expire after 2min
